strings.No root here: dpkg-deb -x the .deb and c: 沒有 root 權限：用 dpkg-deb -x 解開 .deb，再將 usr/bin/diskus 複製到 ~/.local/bin

strings.control whether directory sizes are coun: 控制是否計入目錄本身的大小
strings.download diskus_0.9.0_amd64.deb from Git: 從 GitHub releases 下載 diskus_0.9.0_amd64.deb
strings.extract deb with dpkg-deb -x and copy bi: 用 dpkg-deb -x 解開 deb，並將執行檔複製到 ~/.local/bin
